visualReview.judgment: Small, bounded fine-relief improvement candidate; no substantial realism improvement claimed
observations: The continuous straight vertical fine streaks look slightly less regular, with small variations in short-line spacing particularly around the left and middle lower lip.
The beauty difference is subtle: maximum per-channel delta is 5 or 6 out of 255 in the four actual scenes. These images do not clearly establish rich natural branching.
Coarse furrows, highlights, silhouette, the broad pink colour field and soft outer boundary remain essentially unchanged.
The existing artificial appearance of teeth and the open-mouth cavity remains. R03 does not resolve the separate colour or mouth-interior work.
No new visible silhouette deformation or outside-ROI contamination was observed.
Producer and freshly restored reader images match both visually and in decoded full RGBA bytes.
